record.title: NMC532 | NMC_ocp_PeymanMPM | implementation expression

temperature.description: Not established from the upstream OCP function; no temperature dependence supplied.

x.definition: Electrode lithium fraction c_s/c_s,max in the upstream function; not whole-cell SOC.
x.domain_basis: Mathematical 0..1 evaluation interval. Fit validity and usable operating stoichiometry limits have not been independently established; endpoint voltages may be outside cell operating limits.

cell_link.evidence: Same Mohtat2020 study design as the retrieved author deposit; this PyBaMM variant differs from the bundled original model. Exact specimen correspondence and raw half-cell points are unresolved.

processing.changes: AST-checked local-variable substitution; sto renamed to x. Numeric constants and mathematical operations retained. No upstream function is executed by the importer.

limitations: An implementation expression, not original measured points or a newly fitted curve.
The mathematical domain is not an experimentally verified validity range; do not use endpoint values as operating cutoffs.
No separate lithiation/delithiation branch is supplied; no independent full-cell model validation is claimed.

Peyman MPM / Mohtat2020 implementation, as attributed by upstream function docstrings; The implementation specifies a 5 Ah graphite/NMC532 pouch. Commercial manufacturer, part number, specimen mapping and matching raw full-cell files are not established in this release. SINTEF NMC532 half-cells are a separate source and are not assigned to this pouch.

v0.5: official UMBL research-pouch charging exports retrieved. NMC532 is an implementation label; the deposit does not establish a commercial model or composition assay. Author graphite offset differs.

mohtat-2020.title: Differential Expansion and Voltage Model for Li-ion Batteries at Practical Charging Rates
mohtat-2020.role: Same-study electrochemical/mechanical model and charging observations. Original author-code and PyBaMM implementation variants are distinguished; exact specimen and raw OCP/current/time exports remain unresolved.

pybamm-25-4-2.title: PyBaMM v25.4.2: pinned lithium-ion parameter implementations
pybamm-25-4-2.role: Redistributable software distribution for Prada2013, Chen2020, Marquis2019, Mohtat2020 and NCA_Kim2011. Scientific origin is recorded per function; shared software does not establish shared measurement origin. Prada2013 borrows its OCPs from Afshar2017 and Chen2020. Ecker2015 and Ai2020 modules are also pinned; original and borrowed function origins are recorded separately. ORegan2022 is also pinned; Chen OCP, CRC and Landesfeind origins remain explicit.
